what: blaze-diagnostics lints/syntax/attrs/features/table/lang.rs (rustc's language features, generated by ../table.py) is from rust-lang/rust@ad3d0bc141a, about 3 months older than the pinned nightly-2026-10-27 (rustc cad07cf8e 2026-10-23). The pinned nightly stabilized `never_type` (core says `#[stable(feature = "never_type", since = "1.100.0")]` and no longer enables it), so blaze gives a wrong E0658 "the `!` type is experimental" on every `!` type outside a return position (seen in tests::lints::names::stability::an_unstable_trait_impl_of_stable_types_and_traits_has_no_effect: rustc's own copy of the test dropped `never_type` from its feature list). Any other feature stabilized or removed since ad3d0bc is wrong the same way. Needs: a rust checkout at cad07cf8e (/Volumes/Projects/rust-lang/rust does not have it; I did not fetch), then `python3 crates/blaze-diagnostics/src/lints/syntax/attrs/features/table.py '{"rust": "<checkout>", "out": "crates/blaze-diagnostics/src/lints/syntax/attrs/features/table/lang.rs"}'`. I will then drop the `never_type` gates in checks/features/gates/post.rs (rustc removed them on stabilization) and check hir-ty for never-type fallback (db). Better long term: regenerate the table with each toolchain bump.
